set.body:
Scope
Write the executable model and evaluation contract before changing the objective.

Acceptance criteria
- An ADR separates coverage M, source/target selection, conditional correspondence, warp, and item evidence.
- Directional encoding-to-recall and symmetric comparison estimands are distinguished.
- Duration semantics are explicit for both engines, including fixation splitting/merging behavior.
- Candidate priors, candidate-pool construction, background/null policy, coordinate units, and participant/item cross-fitting are specified.
- gaze_info_bits, odds_bits, log loss, calibration, and diagnostic definitions are mathematically fixed.
- A shared engine result/provenance interface is specified.
- The current v1 implementation and validation artifacts remain reproducible as a frozen baseline.
- Non-goals and claim language are recorded, including no universal-superiority claim.
set.title: GW-1 Freeze the scientific and evaluation contract
